adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `sendAddGuestsEmails` (packages/emails/email-manager.ts) constructs `emailsToSend` for organizer, each team member, and each attendee, then `await Promise.all(emailsToSend)`, which is unbounded concurrency. In `addGuests.handler.ts`, this is awaited (`await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)`) after the DB update and calendar sync, inside a try/catch that would not help if a send never resolves. This is a robustness/performance concern (potential request latency/timeout) rather than a strictly verifiable functional correctness bug from the diff alone.
